checkedAlternates.risk: Air fryers sit on the counter for rapid reheating like microwaves.
checkedAlternates.resolution: An air fryer uses an electric resistance coil and high-speed hot-air convection fan (group-4), not 2.45 GHz microwave radiation (group-1).

checkedAlternates.risk: Induction cooktops heat pans on a flat glass top like radiant electric stoves.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Induction cooktops induce eddy currents directly in ferromagnetic cookware (group-2), rather than heating via glowing resistance elements (group-4).
